info.name: Oracle Health Millennium Platform FHIR R4 API

description.content:
The Oracle Health (Cerner Millennium) FHIR R4 API provides OAuth 2.0-secured access to EHR data in the HL7 FHIR R4 format. It exposes USCDI-aligned resources such as Patient, Practitioner, Observation, Condition, MedicationRequest, DocumentReference, and Encounter for patient-access apps, provider apps, and interoperability partners. The API supports SMART on FHIR app launching and is the successor to the Cerner Millennium DSTU2 FHIR API.
